notes: Variant assumption is a floor bicycle crunch with alternating trunk rotation toward the opposite knee and a controlled cycling leg action. The exact bicycle-maneuver source is a university/ACE research report rather than a peer-reviewed paper, so it is interpreted cautiously and paired with peer-reviewed abdominal EMG sources. The ACE report groups obliques, so the internal/external oblique split is supported by close peer-reviewed crunch and side-bridge evidence plus rotation mechanics.
